patches.description: Blocks MoEngage, PostHog and Firebase events while the Morphe setting is off. Crashlytics is untouched so bugs stay reportable.
patches.name: Analytics toggle

patches.description: Removes Google Play licence verification, so the re-signed app starts outside the Play Store.
patches.name: Bypass PairIP licence check

patches.description: Stops the Developer Options warning and the root / Frida detection that otherwise block the app from starting.
patches.name: Bypass security check

patches.description: Stops the native signature check that closes the app when the APK is not signed by Ather.
patches.name: Bypass signature guard

patches.description: Stops the startup integrity gate that closes the app with a 'modified operating system' message on custom ROMs such as GrapheneOS.
patches.name: Bypass startup integrity

patches.description: Records the charge sessions the scooter reports, so the Morphe history screen can show them.
patches.name: Charge log

patches.description: Turns on the ride-stats feature flag that the app ships disabled.
patches.name: Enable ride stats

patches.description: Turns the track alerts the app receives into local notifications.
patches.name: Local notifications

patches.description: Uses the map provider chosen in the Morphe settings row and falls back to OpenStreetMap when Google Maps or Mappls cannot load.
patches.name: Map provider

patches.description: Registers the Morphe settings, history and ride screens, the background ride service and its boot receiver in the app manifest.
patches.name: Morphe screens

patches.description: Adds a "Morphe settings" row to the account screen, which opens the map provider, analytics and ride log settings.
patches.name: Morphe settings row

patches.description: Makes the setup wizard ask only for Nearby device access, so scooter pairing completes without call log, contact or SMS permissions.
patches.name: Pairing wizard

patches.description: Drops phone location, call log, contact and SMS permissions from the request list, so the app asks only for the permissions its features use.
patches.name: Permission filter

patches.description: Reports Ather's own signing-certificate hash to Google's APIs, so Firebase login and live vehicle data keep working after the app is re-signed.
patches.name: Report Ather's signing certificate

patches.description: Shows the rides recorded on this phone in the ride story screens, including their detail screen.
patches.name: Ride log

patches.description: Shows the K1 authentication token(s) in a dialog and logs it to logcat for pairing with GadgetBridge without requiring root access.
patches.name: Show K1 token(s)

patches.description: Captures the True Health report while the app builds it, so the Morphe history screen can show the part wear.
patches.name: True Health capture
